'''2023 European Championship Marvin Tegeler DS thrawn''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Marvin Tegeler]] at [[2023 European Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Marvin Tegeler]]
* '''Event:''' [[2023 European Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Great Tactician Creates Plans / The Result Is Often Resentment|V19-D-agreattacticiancreatesplans.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:23Euro Tegeler DS Thrawn.txt |Download]]
